question: The lengths of the diagonals of a rhombus are 10 cm and 24 cm. The length of the side of the rhombus is: -
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Side of a **rhombus** (a) = √((d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)²)

Given **diagonals** are 10 cm and 24 cm.

Half of diagonals are 5 cm and 12 cm.

Using **Pythagorean triplet** (5, 12, 13), the side is 13 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First diagonal (d₁) = 10 cm

Second diagonal (d₂) = 24 cm

**Formula Used:**

4 × (Side)² = d₁² + d₂²
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7b0ff70bb4025319cd42ab91a2d43faeceeefbb02cabe03454850334b53ae3a.png] 
**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × a² = 10² + 24²

⇒ 4 × a² = 100 + 576

⇒ 4 × a² = 676

⇒ a² = 676 ÷ 4

⇒ a² = 169

⇒ a = √169

⇒ a = 13 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 13 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus

All sides are equal and **diagonals bisect each other at 90°**.

Area of Rhombus

The area is calculated as 1/2 × d₁ × d₂.

Perimeter of Rhombus

The perimeter is 4 × Side.</p
